reader.requirement: At COBOL-85 both arguments of FUNCTION MOD must be integer arguments (§1989:A.2.2 AR4: integer item, literal, integer function or always-integral expression; never a numeric function, §1989:A.2.3 GR2), refused at compile time when either is not, and for legal integers the function returns argument-1 - argument-2 * INTEGER(argument-1 / argument-2) for every sign combination.

reader.notes: The Verified row Uniform('i') screens both positions through IntegerViolation; every non-integer shape in either position was refused at --std 85, and the results for all four sign combinations, an 18-digit operand and a P-scaled item match RV1's formula. An expression the screen can neither prove nor refute (FUNCTION ORD(A)/2) is accepted and checked at run time, terminating at 85 (witness pb5889_run_time_check_85), which the undefined result of a violating reference permits.

refuter.evidence: Both positions: MOD(FUNCTION RANGE(A 9) 4) = 2, MOD(11 FUNCTION MAX(A B)) = 3, MOD(FUNCTION LENGTH(RS) 4) = 1, MOD(+11 -5) = -4, MOD(FUNCTION DATE-OF-INTEGER(1) 100) = 1 (intfn.cob); MOD(RANGE(TE(ALL)) 2) = 1, MOD(BN PK) = -2 and MOD(PK BN) = 3 over BINARY and PACKED-DECIMAL (both in 1985), MOD(SC 7) = 6 for PIC 9PP, MOD(ZERO 3) = 0, MOD(-11 FUNCTION MIN(TE(ALL)) + 4) = 4 (legal2.cob); largest values: MOD(-999999999999999999 999999999999999998) = 999999999999999997, MOD(999999999999999998 -999999999999999999) = -1, MOD(A * 999999999999999999 7) = 0 (big.cob), each the RV1 formula. Refusal half: ALL '1' (r_alllit.cob), a USAGE INDEX item (r_xi.cob, COBOL6979 §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR5), TE(ALL) (r_all.cob, COBOL1645), FUNCTION MEDIAN and REM (r_meanarg, r_rem), A ** -1 (refuted at A = 2) and 2 ** S (refuted at S = -1) (r_powneg, r_pows), + FUNCTION SQRT(4) (p_uplus.cob) all refused. MOD(7 ZERO) terminates at run time (AR2, undefined). FUNCTION SQRT(A) * 1 is accepted and checked at run time (p_mul1.cob prints 2): the undecided determination, not decisive against the rule at 85. Class c: FUNCTION SIGN, BINARY-LONG refused at 85; comma separators accepted (legal at 85). cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.28.3 AR1 'Argument-1 and argument-2 must be integers'; OK §1989:A.2.2 AR4; OK §1989:A.2.3 GR2; OK §1985:VI.6.2.1; OK §1985:I.1.6.
